content.comment_body: Hello. I'm trying to display the outside temperature on a website, but when it drops below 0°C, I see a value of 65534 instead. How can I make it show negative temperatures?
Which data format are you using—signed or unsigned integer?
You should use a signed integer.
I changed it after your suggestion and it works now. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user could not properly display negative temperature readings on a web page due to using an unsigned data format, which resulted in incorrect values for temperatures below zero. Guidance from the community quickly clarified that a signed integer format is required for accurate representation, showing that users may not always be aware of the impact of different data types on displayed values.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects temperatures—both positive and negative—to be shown accurately on the web display, without needing to manually address formatting issues.
